# ViewsMax API

> Machine endpoint host for ViewsMax (https://viewsmax.com), a social posting +
> link tracking/analytics SaaS. Canonical llms.txt: https://viewsmax.com/llms.txt

- Capability discovery (JSON): https://api.viewsmax.com/api/ai
- MCP endpoint: https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP; OAuth 2.1 + PKCE or `vmx_` API key as Bearer)
- OAuth discovery: https://api.viewsmax.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- REST API reference: https://api.viewsmax.com/docs
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.viewsmax.com/docs.openapi
- Agent setup guide: https://viewsmax.com/ai.md
